name: Newton SysID Adapter
description: Optional portable IsaacLab-Newton SysID boundary that consumes canonical aligned records and emits fitted parameters plus residual evidence.
validators: Newton bridge must consume canonical aligned records instead of embodiment-specific raw logs
fitted parameters and residual metrics must be written as JSON evidence when Newton is enabled
commanded joint positions must come from portable joint_command/command_* fields unless action-as-command is explicitly configured
local log-based SysID remains the fallback when Newton is not configured
if config.sysid.require_newton is true, missing or low-confidence Newton output must fail
